finding.headline: "Passport/Travel Bottleneck" (Diaspora travel to meet family)
finding.problem: "We're travelling in two months and I just found out the passport needs the birth certificate first, which needs the NIN — I'm out of time."
finding.person: Nigerian/diaspora mum who needs baby's passport for UK/US travel to meet relatives but discovers the NPC birth certificate is the bottleneck and doesn't know the order.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module in Diaspora bundle / Standalone (Travel-Ready Baby Docs).". Verdict: PASSES.
